reconstruction.scope: Complete independent long stable/carriage building: plaster shell, pale plinth, green hipped standing-seam roof, three seated ridge vents, real recessed stall/window/door apertures, separate wide double carriage door and supported threshold aprons. Use shared stucco, stone_limestone, metal_standing_seam, wood_plain and storefront surfaces. Hidden rear details and exact roof/threshold layout are approximate; terrain grade adaptation remains draft until inspected.
